description: Query the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine capture index (CDX Server API). Given a URL, return the list of archived captures (timestamp, original URL, HTTP status, MIME type, and content digest). No authentication required. The content digest (SHA1) enables change detection: consecutive identical digests mean the page did not change; a digest flip marks a real content change.

tools.name: cdx_search-captures
tools.description: Return archived captures the Wayback Machine knows for a URL. Supports field selection, time bounds, match scope, and collapsing. Required: url. Optional: output (default: json), fl, from (plus 7 more). Returns array of CdxSearchCapturesItem.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to look up (e.g. example.com or http://example.com/path).

params.name: output
params.description: Output format. Use json for machine-readable rows.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of rows. Negative values return the most recent N.

params.name: matchType
params.description: Match scope for the url parameter.

params.name: collapse
params.description: Collapse adjacent rows on a field (e.g. digest, or timestamp:8 for daily).

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter rows by a field regex (e.g. statuscode:200, !mimetype:warc/revisit).

params.name: showNumPages
params.description: Return only the number of index pages for the query.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based page index for paginated retrieval of large result sets.
